title: The guard's summer post
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The guard is moved to the marina for summer. He tells Wood in the lot: Lot C will be nobody's. Wood says he'll watch it. The guard says it's a parking lot. Wood says he knows what it is.

panels.composition: Lot C. The GUARD with a duffel, his summer post's name on a slip as blocks. WOOD. BARNABY.

balloons.text: Marina, June through August. Lot's nobody's.

image.prompt: a security guard with a duffel bag speaking to a young man and a small dog in an empty parking lot, black and white, no words
a security guard's face, amused and plain, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The guard's hand on the Datsun's roof, once, leaving. A pat. The way Wood's is on the copies.

image.prompt: a security guard resting his hand on a small car's roof for a moment as he leaves, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The lot. The car. Wood. The dog. No guard. Summer. The strip has the lot to itself and finds that it doesn't want it.

notes: The pat on the roof. The lot to himself; he doesn't want it.
